dog.description_text:
Meet Twindle, a sweet and playful girl who got her start on the busy streets of New York. Despite everything she’s been through, Twindle has held onto her gentle spirit and love for people.

She’s the kind of dog who finds joy in the little things: playtime, affection, and simply being by your side. Twindle is now ready to leave her past behind and start a new chapter in a loving home where she can truly thrive.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in adopting or fostering? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
